name: – Nils Ušakovs – After § 48 – Am 52
title: REPORT on general guidelines for the preparation of the 2027 budget, Section III – Commission
part_text: 48a. Calls on the Commission to increase ongoing funding for UNRWA, recognising the Agency’s crucial role in delivering essential services to an increasingly vulnerable population in the Middle East and ensuring the uninterrupted provision of humanitarian assistance;
